g.text: Shannon capacity depends on both bandwidth and power signal-to-noise ratio

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Capacity is in bit/s when B is in Hz. The plotted SNR is received signal power divided by noise power in the relevant bandwidth. Curves hold the SNR value
fixed while varying B; a fixed noise spectral density would generally change SNR when B changes.
